values: 持巨斧猛砸，破坏区域内阻挡。
Zandrok raises his axe and slams it down, destroying all obstacles within the area.
举起斧头蓄力，片刻后砸向目标所在的格子，破坏以目标为中心2格半径内的阻挡，并对范围内敌人造成12% + 2% HP伤害，同时击飞敌人1秒。

Zandrok raises his axe and slams it down on an enemy, destroying all obstacles within 2 tiles of their position. The impact deals 12% + 2% HP damage to enemies in the area and knocks them in the air for 1s.
造成的伤害提升至14% + 2% HP。
Increases the impact damage to 14% + 2% HP.
造成的伤害提升至16% + 2% HP。
Increases the impact damage to 16% + 2% HP.
造成的伤害提升至18% + 2% HP。
Increases the impact damage to 18% + 2% HP.
造成的伤害提升至20% + 2% HP。
Increases the impact damage to 20% + 2% HP.
召唤虚影破坏区域内阻挡。
Zandrok summons illusions to destroy all obstacles in their path.

战斗开始时，召唤5格宽度的自身虚影朝敌方阵营方向冲锋，破坏沿途的阻挡，对敌人造成10% HP伤害，并鼓舞沿途的所有友军。赞东和被鼓舞的其他友军分别永久提升50% + 5%和20% + 2%最大生命值（当前生命值保持不变），并在后续的8秒内提升40 + 4点生命汲取，20点急速与100%移动速度。
主动使用时，鼓舞周围2格范围内的友军，使其获得25 + 4点生命汲取和14点急速，持续8秒，不可叠加。

Passive. When a battle starts, Zandrok summons illusions of himself that charge forward in a 5-tile-wide wedge formation toward the enemy side, dealing 10% HP damage and destroying all obstacles in their path. Any allies they pass through, including Zandrok, become inspired. Inspired Zandrok and allies gain 50% + 5% and 20% + 2% extra max HP respectively until the battle ends, with their current HP remaining unchanged. They also increase their Life Drain by 40 + 4, Haste by 20, and movement speed by 100% for 8s.
Active. Zandrok inspires allies within 2 tiles, increasing their Life Drain by 25 + 4 and Haste by 14 for 8s. Unstackable.
主动使用时，友军获得30 + 4点生命汲取和16点急速。
Increases allies' Life Drain by 30 + 4 and their Haste by 16 when Zandrok casts this skill.
主动使用时，友军获得35 + 4点生命汲取和18点急速。
Increases allies' Life Drain by 35 + 4 and their Haste by 18 when Zandrok casts this skill.
主动使用时，友军获得40 + 4点生命汲取和20点急速。
Increases allies' Life Drain by 40 + 4 and their Haste by 20 when Zandrok casts this skill.
使用强有力的马蹄践踏周围的敌人。
Zandrok stomps the ground, striking nearby enemies.
对一格范围内的敌人造成自身最大生命值12% + 1.5%伤害，并眩晕1.5秒。
Zandrok stomps the ground, dealing damage equal to 12% + 1.5% of his max HP to enemies within 1 tile and stunning them for 1.5s.
造成自身最大生命值伤害提升至13% + 1.5%。
Increases the damage dealt to 13% + 1.5% of Zandrok's max HP.
造成自身最大生命值伤害提升至14% + 1.5%。
Increases the damage dealt to 14% + 1.5% of Zandrok's max HP.
造成自身最大生命值伤害提升至15% + 1.5%。
Increases the damage dealt to 15% + 1.5% of Zandrok's max HP.
提升自身最大生命值，“冲锋号令”期间额外提升最大生命值。
Zandrok increases his max HP during battle. He further increases his max HP while the temporary Rallying Roar buffs are active.
战斗中，最大生命值提升12%，自身受到“冲锋号令”鼓舞期间最大生命值额外提升6%。
Zandrok increases his max HP by 12% during battle. He further increases his max HP by an extra 6% while the temporary buffs granted by Rallying Roar are active.
战斗中，最大生命值提升18%，自身受到“冲锋号令”鼓舞期间最大生命值额外提升9%。
Zandrok increases his max HP by 18% during battle. He further increases his max HP by an extra 9% while the temporary buffs granted by Rallying Roar are active.
战斗中，最大生命值提升24%，自身受到“冲锋号令”鼓舞期间最大生命值额外提升12%。
Zandrok increases his max HP by 24% during battle. He further increases his max HP by an extra 12% while the temporary buffs granted by Rallying Roar are active.
普通攻击附加最大生命值伤害。
Zandrok deals extra damage equal to a portion of his max HP with his normal attacks.
赞东的生命值高于50%初始最大生命值时，普通攻击附加自身最大生命值4%的伤害。
When Zandrok's HP is higher than 50% of his initial max HP, his normal attacks deal extra damage equal to 4% of his max HP.
附加伤害提升至自身最大生命值5%。
Increases the extra damage to 5% of Zandrok's max HP.
受到“冲锋号令”鼓舞的友方角色在下一次普通攻击时，附带15%他们最大生命值的额外伤害，该伤害最高不超过赞东最大生命值的100%。
Enhances the next normal attack of allies inspired by Rallying Roar, making it deal extra damage equal to 15% of their own max HP. This extra damage cannot exceed 100% of Zandrok's max HP.
附加伤害提升至自身最大生命值6%。
Increases the extra damage to 6% of Zandrok's max HP.
溢出治疗转化为最大生命。
Any excess healing Zandrok receives is converted into max HP.
自身受到治疗时，溢出的部分将转化为最大生命值，提升的最大生命值至多不超过50%初始最大生命值。
Any excess healing Zandrok receives is converted into extra max HP. The total max HP gained from this effect cannot exceed 50% of his initial max HP.
